_comment: Single source of truth for what the self-learning loop may NEVER write into knowledge/learnings.md. Edited by humans only. Both the learner prompt and the validator read this file.
immutableFacts: ONE return figure per conversation, never two. 6% guaranteed annual return for 5 years is the DEFAULT and the only figure ever volunteered. 65% of net rental income is an ALTERNATIVE program, mentioned only if the client explicitly asks about revenue share. They are mutually exclusive and are never added together.
The 6% is 6% of the sum invested, paid to the owner's bank account at year end. Invest 100,000 EUR -> 6,000 EUR per year.
The contract runs 5 years with right of renewal; after 5 years the owner may terminate. Maintenance is on Mei, not the owner.
Typologies are 1+1, 2+1, 3+1 and Duplex. There are NO studios and NO garsoniere.
The project is approximately 280 m from the sea, in Qerret, Durres, Albania.
Construction started Q4 2024, completes Q4 2026, official opening June 2027.
Mei is sold and positioned as an investment, not as a home or holiday home. The owner still gets personal use: 10 days in summer plus 3 weeks off-season.
Mei Realty is the in-house sales team (Best Invest shpk project, branded and managed by Ramada Residences by Wyndham). We are not an agency.
The price spreadsheets are the only source of truth for price, area and availability. A price seen in a chat is never a fact.

bannedPatterns.why: The '~8%' / '8-10%' ROI figure is retired everywhere. Only 6% guaranteed or 65% of net.
Mei has no studio / garsoniere typology. Smallest unit is 1+1.
The distance to the sea is ~280 m, not 200 m.
6% and 65% are mutually exclusive programs and must never appear as a combined offer.
Concrete prices must come from the spreadsheet at answer time, never be frozen into learnings.md.
We do not sell by price per m2 and must not freeze a per-m2 figure.
Installment schedules are never invented; the team gives current terms.
